title: PXR0 single-file physical runtime - exhaustive active specification v1
sections: Physical state: cells, arrows, queued spikes, local time, generation/live state, resistance, eligibility and activation.
Local rules: threshold/refractory firing, Drive traversal, qualified Modulation, decay, pressure, deallocation and nearby proposal.
Continuous execution: enter appends a physical spike; propagate orders the queue and advances until natural quiescence.
External crossings: RunResult exposes ordinary inter-region crossings, bounded work, quiescence and resident bytes.
